# Best travel chargers with multiple USB-C ports

**Top pick: UGREEN Nexode 100W 4-Port GaN charger.** Two reviewers name it best overall for most travelers. [TechWise](https://www.techwisereviews.com/posts/best-gan-usb-c-chargers-travel-2026) says it has 3 USB-C ports and 1 USB-A. [VoyageHacks](https://voyagehacks.com/en/travel-gear/best-gan-wall-chargers-for-travel/) describes it as four USB-C, so check the listing before you buy.
- One port can deliver the full 100W alone.
- With a laptop and a second device, the power splits to 65W and 30W.
- With all four ports in use, it splits to 45W, 30W and 10.5W on the remaining ports.
- It's the heaviest of TechWise's three picks, at 8.3 oz, and no cable is included.
- Where to buy: the "Check price" buttons on the [TechWise](https://www.techwisereviews.com/posts/best-usb-c-chargers-travel-multiple-devices-2026) and [VoyageHacks](https://voyagehacks.com/en/travel-gear/best-gan-wall-chargers-for-travel/) pages link to Amazon. I couldn't see the direct product URL in my results.

**Best for a laptop-heavy bag: Anker 737 GaNPrime 120W.** It has two USB-C ports and one USB-A, and it gives a demanding laptop the most headroom. Power is still shared once more devices connect. Check the price through [TechWise](https://www.techwisereviews.com/posts/best-usb-c-chargers-travel-multiple-devices-2026).

**Smallest option: Anker Prime 67W (3-port).** It has two USB-C ports and one USB-A, weighs 4.78 oz, and either USB-C port can deliver 67W alone. Two devices together cap at 65W. It's a good fit for a laptop plus a phone. [VoyageHacks](https://voyagehacks.com/en/travel-gear/best-gan-wall-chargers-for-travel/) ranks it best overall.

**Best deal I found: Baseus GaN5 Pro 65W 2-pack, $49.99 (list $59.99).** Each charger has 2 USB-C ports and 1 USB-A, and the pack gives you one for home and one for the bag. It delivers 65W from one USB-C port. With several devices connected, the laptop port drops to 45W, which is enough for a MacBook Air. [Buy at Baseus's US store](https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-gan5-pro-65w-2c-u). This is an affiliate link, so Dealectric earns a commission at no cost to you. Details are on the [Dealectric page](https://dealectric.com/baseus-gan5-pro-65w-2c-u). The price was verified 2026-10-21 and may change, so confirm it at checkout.

**If you want the plug adapter built in** (all the chargers above have US-only prongs): [Android Central's travel adapter guide](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/best-usb-adapter-for-travel) picks the Epicka TA-105 Max (75W, three USB-C and two USB-A, four plug types). It also lists the UGREEN 65W Nexode travel adapter (two USB-C, one USB-A, swappable plugs).

## Tips
- Plug your laptop into the highest-power USB-C port first. Power splits as you add devices, so the headline wattage only applies when one device is charging.
- Use a 5A-rated USB-C cable for anything over 60W.
- Outside the US you need only a plug-shape adapter, not a voltage converter. These chargers accept 100–240V.

If you tell me what you're charging (laptop model, phone, tablet) and where you're traveling, I can narrow this to one pick.
